"""Generate an unapplied proposal; do not edit production pl_runtime.py."""
import difflib
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
original=(root/'pl_runtime.py').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
proposed=original.replace('self.dma.write(0x04, 0x1770)',
'''# Only IRQ latches are W1C; cause bits are RO and need reset/recovery.
        self.dma.write(0x04, 0x7000)''').replace('if status & 0x770:', 'if status & 0x4770:')
proposed=proposed.replace('''        if current != request or not self.ctrl.read(0x24) & 0x10:
            raise RuntimeError('PL frame ownership expired/cancelled; refusing stale result')''',
'''        active = bool(self.ctrl.read(0x24) & 0x10)
        if current != request or not active:
            # Same expired identity plus recovery reason identifies this timeout;
            # do not classify an unrelated old sticky bit as the current cause.
            reason = self.ctrl.read(0xD0)
            timeout_count = self.ctrl.read(0xD8)
            if current == request and not active and reason == 1 and timeout_count:
                raise TimeoutError('PL owner timeout (~1 second from dispatch); '
                                   'frame ownership expired/cancelled; refusing stale result: '
                                   + str(self.snapshot()))
            raise RuntimeError('PL frame ownership expired/cancelled; refusing stale result: '
                               + str(self.snapshot()))''')
proposed=proposed.replace('''left, top = max(0, min(639, math.floor(x))), max(0, min(479, math.floor(y)))
            right, bottom = min(640, math.ceil(x + w)), min(480, math.ceil(y + h))''',
'''left, top = max(0, min(640, math.floor(x))), max(0, min(480, math.floor(y)))
            right, bottom = max(0, min(640, math.ceil(x + w))), max(0, min(480, math.ceil(y + h)))''')
proposed=proposed.replace("('stale_results', 0x7C), ('aborted', 0x84), ('fusion', 0xF8))}",
"""('stale_results', 0x7C), ('aborted', 0x84), ('fusion', 0xF8),
                 ('profiler_timeouts', 0xB4), ('profiler_flags', 0xB8),
                 ('recovery_reason', 0xD0), ('recovery_timeouts', 0xD8))}""")
assert original!=proposed
compile(proposed,'pl_runtime_proposal','exec')
diff=''.join(difflib.unified_diff(original.splitlines(True),proposed.splitlines(True),
    fromfile='a/runtime/pl_runtime.py',tofile='b/runtime/pl_runtime.py'))
(root/'tests/pl_runtime_proposal.patch').write_text(diff,encoding='utf-8')
# Keep only the reviewable patch, never overwrite the production file.
print('Unapplied patch generated and syntax checked; production SHA256 '+
      hashlib.sha256((root/'pl_runtime.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest())
